newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 800 MW firm peak power Sat, Sun, Mon.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 800 MW firm peak power Sat, Sun, Mon.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 800 MW of firm on-peak power and 500 MW of off-peak power for Saturday, Sunday and Monday deliveries, the federal agency said Thursday.
BPA also offered up to 500 MW of non-firm power during off-peak hours (0100-0600 and 2300-2400 PST) for each day.
Off-peak prices were unchanged at $18.00 to $18.50 per megawatt hour (MWh).
On-peak firm prices were unchanged for Saturday and Monday at $30.00 per MWh in the Northwest and $30.75 for California-Oregon border (COB).
Peak firm power for Sunday was priced slightly lower at $28.00 for Northwest deals and $28.75 for COB.
For Friday, BPA had offered up to 800 MW of firm power during both light and heavy load hours as well as another 800 MW of non-firm during light load hours.
